newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse dominated by results, data watch.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse dominated by results, data watch.

text.p: The Brussels bourse was lower in midmorning trade as profit taking gripped the market ahead of the U.S. employment report US-ECI due late in the session.

Early action was dominated by trade in industrials Solvay and PetroFina, both of which released first half results late on Thursday. "The results from Solvay were not beautiful, those of PetroFina were better," one trader commented.
By 0930 GMT, the Bel-20 index was 14.21 points, or 0.55 percent lower, at 2,565.20 points, with fourteen issues in negative territory and six higher.

News interim earnings at PetroFina rose a more-than-expected 61 percent to 10.8 billion francs lifted the company's share 4.0 percent in early trade, though by mid-morning it had settled some 2.50 percent higher at 15,375 francs.
PetroFina's gain helped its main shareholder Electrafina, a notable market laggard in 1997, rise to a year high of 3,850 francs.
Chemicals maker Solvay however failed to benefit from news of a three percent rise in first half current earnings to 6.1 billion francs. By mid-morning, it was down 1.69 percent at 23,200 francs.
Chemicals and drugs group UCB was also active, extending losses made Thursday on the back of its first half results as investors continued to take profit after the share's strong gains this year.
By mid-morning UCB was 2.45 percent lower at 131,200 francs.
Steel wire and cord maker Bekaert was down 4.15 percent at 26,000 francs.
